anya_sdk: Quick Q — hitting a weird auth 401 when rotating SA JWTs in the Node SDK. Same JWT works with curl but SDK token-exchange call fails with \"aud claim mismatch\". Anyone run into this?

sam_devex: Can you paste the exchange payload (redact secrets) and how you generate the JWT?

anya_sdk: Yup. Generated JWT (redacted): `{"iss":"svc-account@proj","sub":"svc-account@proj","aud":"https://oauth.redwood.example/token","exp":...}`
Exchange request (what SDK does):
```
POST /token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange&subject_token=<jwt>&subject_token_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt&requested_token_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token
```
Response: 401 `\{"error":"invalid_grant", "error_description":"aud claim invalid"\}`

brian_infra: That usually means the token's aud is set to the token endpoint itself instead of the resource you want access to. Some providers require `aud` to match the target API or client id for token-exchange flows. Curl probably worked because you were testing a different JWT or included `audience` param.

maria_security: Also verify provider config: some OIDC brokers enforce `azp` or a whitelist on `iss`/`sub`. aud mismatch isn't a fatal SDK bug — it's about what the token was minted for. Avoid embedding user emails in aud.

anya_sdk: Ah — I see. I minted JWT with default aud from the helper script. Will try swapping aud -> `https://api.redwood.ai` and re-exchange.

lee_engineer: One more thing: on Node streaming we saw stale tokens used for a few seconds during rotation. SDK has a tiny clock skew and queue for refreshes; if you rotate very frequently (<5s) you'll hit races. Recommend bumping `auth.refreshAheadSec` to 10 in config or doing a manual invalidate on the auth instance before opening a long-lived stream.

sam_devex: We should also add a safety retry: on 401, do a single forced refresh and retry the request once. Keeps flakiness down without looping. I'll leave a review comment in the PR.

anya_sdk: Will do. Quick code snippet I'm planning to add to Node SDK config: `clientOptions.auth = { refreshAheadSec: 10, retryOn401: true }` — is that fine?

maria_security: That's acceptable. Make sure the default is conservative (5s) and we document tradeoffs. Also ensure logs redact JWTs — we only need error codes and request ids.

ci-bot: Deploy queued: branch=auth-audience-fix, job=auth-unit-tests (pass), integration-tests (running) :gear:

anya_sdk: Thanks all — opening PR now and tagging @sam_devex for review. If integration is flaky I'll increase timeout on the exchange test.

sam_devex: Sounds good. Ping me after CI green and I'll merge. :thumbsup:
